entries.label: Independent America
entries.summary: Trump's 'America first' approach pulls the US away from global leadership.
entries.quote: Trump's “America first” philosophy and his pledge to “make America great again” build on the most core of American values: independence.

entries.label: China overreacts
entries.summary: China's leadership transition year raises the risk of overreaction.
entries.quote: China's scheduled leadership transition this fall will shape its political and economic trajectory for a decade or more.

entries.label: A weaker Merkel
entries.summary: European risks materialise as Merkel's leadership weakens.
entries.quote: This year will bring another wave of political risks in Europe, and some of them will surely materialize amid a weakening of the leadership of German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

entries.label: No reform
entries.summary: Governments avoid structural reform, hurting growth.
entries.quote: Leadership will also be lacking this year on other issues, as political officials in both developed and emerging economies avoid structural reform, undermining prospects for growth and new opportunities for investors.

entries.label: Technology and the Middle East
entries.summary: Technology exposes weak Middle Eastern governments.
entries.quote: Despite a veneer of effective autocracy, Middle Eastern governments have been weak for decades.

entries.label: Central banks get political
entries.summary: Central banks come under political attack in advanced economies.
entries.quote: For the first time in decades, central banks face attack not just in emerging markets but in the US, the Eurozone, and the UK.

entries.label: The White House vs Silicon Valley
entries.summary: Tech leaders and the Trump administration clash.
entries.quote: Technology leaders from California, the major state that voted in largest numbers against Trump in the election, have a bone to pick with the new president.

entries.label: Turkey
entries.summary: Erdogan campaigns hard to expand presidential power.
entries.quote: Voters are close to evenly split on the question of expanding the president's powers, and Erdogan will have to mount an aggressive campaign to win them over.

entries.label: North Korea
entries.summary: North Korea has a big and dangerous year.
entries.quote: 2017 will be a big year for North Korea. That's not a good thing.

entries.label: South Africa
entries.summary: The Zuma crisis worsens and puts the economy at risk.
entries.quote: The political crisis pitting President Jacob Zuma against opponents within and beyond the ruling African National Congress (ANC) will worsen in 2017, putting the South African economy at greater risk and damaging regional stability.

entries.label: US domestic policy
entries.summary: Eurasia Group sees the US domestic outlook as neutral to positive in 2017.
entries.quote: At least for 2017, the US domestic outlook is neutral to positive.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: India versus Pakistan
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects both leaders to focus on domestic issues.
entries.quote: Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi will focus on domestic issues.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.

entries.label: Brazil
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects pressure on Brazil's president to also speed reforms.
entries.quote: Pressures on  Brazil's president will create difficulties but also more urgency for legislators to approve important reforms.
entries.note: Red herrings are not ranked; rank is the printed order.
